note: Quality golden set for Arboris, 30 prompts across task types. Each case lists key facts a correct answer must contain (case-insensitive substring match). This is a weak, transparent judge, not a real quality judge: it catches missing facts and wrong answers, it does not judge style, completeness, or reasoning. Creative cases only check topic, not quality. Run live answers through scripts/quality_check.py; do not run this against the demo provider's canned answers, which were not written to these prompts.
